prompts.name: Correct punctuation and grammar
prompts.description: Clean up punctuation and grammar while preserving wording.
prompts.template: Correct punctuation and grammar in the transcript with minimal wording changes. Preserve meaning, tone, and word choice. Return only the corrected text.

prompts.name: Concise rewrite
prompts.description: Rewrite the transcript into concise, clear wording.
prompts.template: Correct punctuation and grammar, then rewrite the transcript concisely for clarity. Remove filler, repetition, and rambling while preserving the intended meaning. Return only the rewritten text.
